```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c(
    total = "B15003_001",
    bachelors = "B15003_022",
    masters = "B15003_023",
    professional = "B15003_024",
    doctorate = "B15003_025"
  ),
  summary_var = "B15003_001",
  year = 2020
)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c("B15003_001", "B15003_022", "B15003_023", "B15003_024", "B15003_025"),
  year = 2020,
  geometry = FALSE,
  summary_var = "B15003_001"
)
```

```{r}
edu_state |>
  filter(variable %in% c("B15003_022", "B15003_023", "B15003_024", "B15003_025")) |>
  group_by(GEOID, NAME) |>
  summarize(
    percent_bachelors_or_higher = sum(estimate) / first(summary_est) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = percent_bachelors_or_higher,
    y = fct_reorder(NAME, percent_bachelors_or_higher)
  )) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Adults with a Bachelor's Degree or Higher by State",
    x = "Adults with a bachelor's degree or higher (%)",
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
